SELECT ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE, COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
WHERE ISLATEST = 1
GROUP BY ACID, BANK_ID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

--1
SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

--2
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY ACID, CURRENT_EOD_DATE DESC, INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN , 
* INTO BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230920
FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES;

--3
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230920

--4
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

--5
TRUNCATE TABLE BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

--6
UPDATE BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230920 SET ISLATEST = 0 WHERE RN > 1

--7
INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
SELECT
[BANK_ID]
,[ACID]
,[PREVIOUS_CURRBAL]
,[PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL]
,[CURRENT_EOD_DATE]
,[ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL]
,[ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL]
,[isActive]
,[isLatest]
,[BNK_CODE]
,[SOURCE_CODE]
,[FILE_NAME]
,[insert_dttm]
FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES_WITH_DUP_20230920;

--8
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES

--9
SELECT COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES
WHERE ISLATEST = 1;
